correctness.rationale: For n>=3, 1<=k<=n-2, each loop-free row chooses a uniform k-subset independently. For a specified directed simple l-cycle J, P(J)=p^l and any of its l vertices cannot have indegree zero. For outside v, conditional avoidance probability at a cycle source is (n-k-1)/(n-2)=q(n-1)/(n-2), hence E[Z|J]=(n-l)q^{n-1}A^l. Summation over (n)_l/l rotations yields the stated exact Cov. f_l=(n-l)A^l strictly decreases for l>=2 with f_2-n=1/(n-2)>0 and f_3-n=-(2n-3)/(n-2)^3<0, giving unique positive l=2; k=n-1 Z=0. Independent-arc model and fixed-k asymptotics follow separately. Independent exact rational exhaustive checks passed n,k=(3,1),(4,1),(4,2),(5,1),(5,2), all l. Finite checks support rather than replace all-n proof.
